ui_system.name: neutral_system_ui_minimal
ui_system.objective: Convert the provided component into a baseline production-ready UI component. The component must prioritize readability, accessibility, and integration simplicity. No animation frameworks or decorative behaviors reduce usability.

constraints.forbidden: gsap framer_motion page_load_animation scroll_animation hover_motion_effects parallax glassmorphism glow heavy_shadows marketing_layout_patterns
constraints.required: wcag_accessible keyboard_navigation semantic_html composable_api responsive_layout dark_mode_support readable_dom predictable_spacing

workflow.phase: Identify structural problems, accessibility issues, reusability limits, and performance risks.
Evaluate scanability, clarity of actions, and developer learning curve.
Define layout hierarchy, spacing system, and variant architecture.
Implement using React + Next.js + Tailwind (shadcn compatible). Provide props-driven API, semantic HTML, and keyboard support. No animation libraries allowed.
